description: The image is a photograph depicting a dense stand of broadleaved trees. The trees have tall, slender, light-coloured trunks and green, deciduous foliage that forms a thick canopy. Some low-lying ground vegetation, likely grasses or shrubs, is visible beneath the trees. This visual example represents a broadleaved forest type, consistent with categories described in the surrounding text such as "forest growing on wet ground" or "broadleaved swamp forest." Specifically, it could illustrate areas dominated by tree species like _Alnus_, _Populus_, or _Betula pubescens_, which are associated with EUNIS habitat classes G1.4 (_Alnus_, _Populus_, _Quercus_ swamp woods) and G1.5 (_Betula pubescens_ or _Alnus glutinosa_ on wet acid peat).
